<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Invalid verification code</span></div>

## Why it happens

- The code was typed wrong, or it expired before it was entered.
- The phone's clock is off. Authenticator app codes depend on the time; a phone a minute or more off gives wrong codes.
- A code sent by e-mail or SMS was replaced by a newer one.
- A backup code was already used.

## Fix it

- Set the phone's time to automatic and try a fresh code.
- For e-mail or SMS, use **Resend code** and enter the newest code.
- Use one of your backup codes if you have them.
- Lost the authenticator and the backup codes: from the release after 4.3.0.57, an administrator can open the user and use **Reset two-factor authentication**. In 4.3.0.57, contact support.

## Check that it worked

Sign-in continues to the Home page.
